messages.subject: spectro and osc problem
parts:
Hi, I'm new to see wave and I have a problem .... maybe due to inexperience ...

when I tray to get a spectrogram with the oscillogram and the from= to= parameters, I get the oscillogram correctly set to the time interval, but the spectrogram of the whole file.

here the command .... see wave is version 1.7.3
spectro(test, osc=TRUE, from=50, to=70) 


Any hint on how to solve the problem ?

Gianni

messages.author: 4e3305614e448c1d
messages.subject: Re: spectro and osc problem
parts:
Hi Gianni,

I think you have to try the 'tlim' argument.

Try this:
data(tico)
spectro(tico, osc=TRUE, tlim=c(0.5,1)) #zoom from 0.5 seconds to 1

Obs.: I'm using seewave version 1.7.2

I hope this help you.


Cássio Rachid Simões

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Re: spectro and osc problem
parts:
You are right! For 'oscillo()' function the arguments are 'from' and 'to'. ^^

If you need, you have the option (in 'spectro()' function) to use 'xlim' argument in place of 'tlim' argument. This argument ('xlim') doesn't work with 'tico' data (I don't know why), but all of my sripts I've used him and I never had problems.

Try open one of your files and run the spectro like below:

spectro(your.file, osc=T, xlim=c(0.5,1)) #zoom from 0.5 to 1 seconds

Cássio Rachid Simões
